title: POSCO expands lithium business with major order from CATL
dek: POSCO is expanding its lithium business with a major order from CATL, according to electrive.com.
summary: According to a headline from electrive.com, POSCO is expanding its lithium business on the back of a major order from CATL. The publisher's excerpt is absent, so the order's volume, value and timing are not given.
keyFacts: Order from CATL described as major
whyItMatters: The item suggests the POSCO group continues to diversify into battery materials alongside steel, which could influence how it allocates capital between its core and new businesses.
implications: Investors and analysts may watch whether battery-materials earnings increasingly offset cyclicality in POSCO's steel operations; there is no direct effect on steel markets indicated.
